changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Store an immutable accountability record whenever authorized managed attendance creates or changes an attendance segment.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".attendance_adjustment_audit ADD CONSTRAINT chk_attendance_adjustment_audit_operation CHECK (operation IN ('CREATE', 'UPDATE')), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_attendance_adjustment_audit_reason CHECK (char_length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 5 AND 500), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_attendance_adjustment_audit_before_values CHECK ( (operation = 'CREATE' AND before_values IS NULL) OR (operation = 'UPDATE' AND before_values IS NOT NULL) );

changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Create attendance:regularize for active Attendance subscribers, then grant the approved ALL scope only to active HR/admin roles. Rollback intentionally preserves approved authorization.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO "${schema}".permission ( id, resource, action, module_id, description ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'attendance', 'regularize', module.id, 'Create or adjust managed attendance with an auditable reason' FROM kabipay_ops.module AS module WHERE module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' AND module.is_active = true AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kabipay_ops.tenant_subscription AS subscription JOIN "${schema}".role AS tenant_role ON tenant_role.tenant_id = subscription.tenant_id WHERE subscription.module_id = module.id AND subscription.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subscription.is_deleted = false ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".permission AS existing_permission WHERE existing_permission.resource = 'attendance' AND existing_permission.action = 'regularize' AND existing_permission.module_id = module.id );

WITH regularize_permission AS ( SELECT permission.id FROM "${schema}".permission AS permission JOIN kabipay_ops.module AS module ON module.id = permission.module_id WHERE permission.resource = 'attendance' AND permission.action = 'regularize' AND module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' AND module.is_active = true ), active_admin_roles AS ( SELECT tenant_role.id, tenant_role.tenant_id FROM "${schema}".role AS tenant_role JOIN kabipay_ops.tenant_subscription AS subscription ON subscription.tenant_id = tenant_role.tenant_id JOIN kabipay_ops.module AS module ON module.id = subscription.module_id WHERE tenant_role.is_deleted = false AND subscription.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subscription.is_deleted = false AND module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' AND module.is_active = true AND UPPER(TRIM(tenant_role.name)) IN ('HR_ADMIN', 'TENANT_ADMIN', 'ORG_ADMIN') ) INSERT INTO "${schema}".role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT active_admin_roles.id, regularize_permission.id FROM active_admin_roles CROSS JOIN regularize_permission ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;

WITH regularize_permission AS ( SELECT permission.id FROM "${schema}".permission AS permission JOIN kabipay_ops.module AS module ON module.id = permission.module_id WHERE permission.resource = 'attendance' AND permission.action = 'regularize' AND module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' AND module.is_active = true ), active_admin_roles AS ( SELECT tenant_role.id, tenant_role.tenant_id FROM "${schema}".role AS tenant_role JOIN kabipay_ops.tenant_subscription AS subscription ON subscription.tenant_id = tenant_role.tenant_id JOIN kabipay_ops.module AS module ON module.id = subscription.module_id WHERE tenant_role.is_deleted = false AND subscription.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subscription.is_deleted = false AND module.code = 'ATTENDANCE' AND module.is_active = true AND UPPER(TRIM(tenant_role.name)) IN ('HR_ADMIN', 'TENANT_ADMIN', 'ORG_ADMIN') ) INSERT INTO "${schema}".permission_scope (id, tenant_id, role_id, resource, action, scope_type) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), active_admin_roles.tenant_id, active_admin_roles.id, 'attendance', 'regularize', 'ALL' FROM active_admin_roles WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM regularize_permission) ON CONFLICT (role_id, resource, action) DO UPDATE SET scope_type = EXCLUDED.scope_type;
